seed_rule: uniform among top ceil(1 percent) eligible nodes by domain degree, ties by ASN
growth_rule: largest unmet absolute stratum quota on connected frontier, seeded random ties and nodes; retain every induced edge
quota_rule: proportional largest remainder in eligible largest component; no outcome-based tuning
control: stratified uniform nodes with same quotas and seed, no connectivity constraint
known_domain: sample on p2c/p2p edges only; preserve unknown/conflicting induced edges as inactive evidence
boundary: save every full-union edge with exactly one selected endpoint; no invented reconnecting links
prefixes: preserve all selected-AS observed prefix/source rows; observations are not ownership or executable addresses
replication: seed sensitivity on a shared source graph, not independent Internet observations

acceptance.scientific_representativeness: not established; report bias without accepting a universal representativeness threshold
